result.topic_en: Calculations on bilinear forms X, Y in two sets of variables, the associated quadratic forms (determinants), and the transformation behaviour of products of linear forms and their determinants (lm_1 - l_1 m) under a linear substitution x = αx' + βy', y = γx' + δy'.
result.transcription:
$X = pxx' + p'xy' + p''yx' + p'''yy'$
$Y = qxx' + q'xy' + q''yx' + q'''yy'$
$(pq'' - qp'')x'^2 + (pq''' - qp''' + p'q'' - q'p'')x'y' + (p'q''' - q'p''')y'^2 = \mathfrak{F}'$
$(pq' - qp')x^2 + (pq''' - qp''' - p'q'' + q'p'')xy + (p''q''' - q''p''')y^2 = \mathfrak{F}$
$\mathfrak{F}'_x = X(q'x' + q'''y') - Y(p'x' + p'''y')$
$\mathfrak{F}'_y = Y(px' + p'y') - X(qx' + q'y')$
$\mathfrak{F}_{x'} = X(q'x + q'''y) - Y(p'x + p'''y)$
$\mathfrak{F}_{y'} = Y(px + p''y) - X(qx + q''y)$
$(\mathfrak{L}X + \mathfrak{M}Y)^m = (lx + my)^m (l'x' + m'y')^m$
$(\mathfrak{L}_1X + \mathfrak{M}_1Y)^m = (l_1x + m_1y)^m (l_1'x' + m_1'y')^m$

$(\mathfrak{L}\mathfrak{M}_1 - \mathfrak{L}_1\mathfrak{M})^m$
$\mathfrak{L} \mp (lq'' - mq)x' + (lq''' - mq')y'$
$\mathfrak{M} \mp (mp - lp'')x' + (mp' - lp''')y'$
$[(lq'' - mq)(m_1p - l_1p'') - (l_1q'' - m_1q)(mp - lp'')]x'^2 + [(lq'' - mq)(m_1p' - l_1p''') + (lq''' - mq')(m_1p - l_1p'')$
$- (l_1q'' - m_1q)(mp' - lp''') - (l_1q''' - m_1q')(mp - lp'')]x'y'$
$(lm_1 - ml_1)(pq'' - qp'')x'^2$
$+ (lm_1 - l_1m)(q''p' + q'''p - qp''' - q'p'')x'y'$
$(\mathfrak{L}\mathfrak{M}_1 - \mathfrak{L}_1\mathfrak{M})^m \mathfrak{F}'^m = (l'x' + m'y')^m (l_1'x' + m_1'y')^m (lm_1 - l_1m)^m$

$(lx + my)^m = (l'x' + m'y')^m$
$(l_1x + m_1y)^n = (l_1'x' + m_1'y')^m$
$x = \alpha x' + \beta y'$
$y = \gamma x' + \delta y'$
$(lm_1 - l_1m)^K (lx + my)^{m-K} (l_1x + m_1y)^{n-K} (\alpha\delta - \beta\gamma)^K$
$= (l_1'm_1' - l_1'm_1')^K (l'x' + m'y')^{m-K} (l_1'x' + m_1'y')^{n-K}$

$(lx + my)^{m-r} [x'(l\alpha + m\gamma) + y'(l\beta + m\delta)]^r = (l'x' + m'y')^m$

$[x'(l\alpha + m\gamma) + y'(l\beta + m\delta)]^m = (l'x' + m'y')^m$
$(l\alpha + m\gamma)^{p-r} (l\beta + m\delta)^{q-s} (l\alpha + m\gamma)^r (l\beta + m\delta)^s$
$= l'^p m'^q$
$(l\beta + m\delta)^t m^{\alpha}(l\alpha + m\gamma) = \lambda^t \mu^{m}$ [?]
$l'^p m'^q = \lambda'^{p-r} \mu'^{q-s}$

$(lx + my)^m = (l'x' + m'y')^m$
$[-(-](l_1x + m_1y)^m = (l_1'x' + m_1'y')^m$
$(l'm_1' - l_1'm')^m = [(l\alpha + m\gamma)(l_1\beta + m_1\delta) - (l_1\alpha + m_1\gamma)(l\beta + m\delta)]^m$
$= (lm_1 - l_1m)^m (\alpha\delta - \beta\gamma)^m$

$\lambda'^{p-r} \mu'^{q-s} = (\lambda\alpha + \mu\gamma)^{p-r} (\lambda\beta + \mu\delta)^{q-s}$
$(\lambda x + \mu y)^{m-r-s} = (\lambda'x' + \mu'y')^{m-r-s}$
$m-r-s = n-r_1-s_1 = K$
$(\lambda_1x + \mu_1y)^{n-r_1-s_1} = (\lambda_1'x' + \mu_1'y')^{m-r_1-s_1}$
$(\lambda'\mu_1' - \lambda_1'\mu')^{K} = (\lambda\mu_1 - \lambda_1\mu)^K (\alpha\delta - \beta\gamma)^K$
$l_1'^{r_1} m_1'^{s_1} l'^r m'^s (\lambda'm_1' - l_1'm_1')^K = (\lambda m_1 - l_1m)^K (l\beta + m\delta)^s (l\alpha + m\gamma)^r (l_1\beta + m_1\delta)^{s_1}$
$(l_1\alpha + m_1\gamma)^{r_1} (\alpha\delta - \beta\gamma)^K$

methods.what: Definition of two bilinear forms in (x,y) and (x',y')
Quadratic form in x',y' obtained as a determinant of the coefficients of the two bilinear forms
Partial derivatives of the quadratic form expressed through X and Y
Determinant of linear combinations factoring as (lm_1 - l_1m) times the quadratic form
Determinant of two linear forms is multiplied by the substitution determinant under a linear change of variables
methods.quote:
$(l'm_1' - l_1'm')^m = [(l\alpha + m\gamma)(l_1\beta + m_1\delta) - (l_1\alpha + m_1\gamma)(l\beta + m\delta)]^m$
$= (lm_1 - l_1m)^m (\alpha\delta - \beta\gamma)^m$

methods.what: Transformation law for products of powers of linear forms and their determinant (covariant-type relation)
methods.quote:
$(lm_1 - l_1m)^K (lx + my)^{m-K} (l_1x + m_1y)^{n-K} (\alpha\delta - \beta\gamma)^K$
$= (l_1'm_1' - l_1'm_1')^K (l'x' + m'y')^{m-K} (l_1'x' + m_1'y')^{n-K}$
